name: Cupbop Korean BBQ (Draper / Herriman / Logan) Spice Level #1–#2 Chicken or Beef Bop Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Cupbop — Korean BBQ in a Cup (Draper, Herriman, South Jordan & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Utah's homegrown Korean BBQ bowl chain lets you choose your exact heat level from #1 (Sweet & Zero Spice) to #10, and layers steamed white rice, sweet potato glass noodles (japchae), and grilled chicken (KKO KKO) or beef bulgogi (B Bop).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the KKO KKO Bop (grilled chicken) or B Bop (beef bulgogi) at **Spice Level #1 (Sweet, 0% spicy)** or **#2**, ask for **"No Cabbage"** (double rice and glass noodles instead), and light mayo/teriyaki drizzle.
watchOuts: Always ask for "No Raw Cabbage" and stay at Spice Level #1 or #2!
